errors.text_span: Категориите са изброени във възходящ ред
errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted in any particular order, and certainly not in ascending order of their values. The description later correctly states they are not sorted, making this part contradictory and incorrect.

errors.text_span: сините представляват по-малко често посочвани действия, а червените – по-често посочвани
errors.evidence: The description interprets the meaning of the colors, which is forbidden by the prompt. This statement is also an overgeneralization, as not all red bars are longer than all blue bars (e.g., the red bar at ~115 is longer than the blue bar at ~95, but shorter than other red bars).
The value for the category „Наемане на работници/служители с договор...“ is approximately 180, not 190. The bar ends visibly below the 190 mark.
The description states one of the lowest values is 30, but the corresponding bar for „Осъществяване на бартерни сделки“ has a value of approximately 20.

errors.text_span: няма визуално подчертаване на конкретни стълбове
errors.evidence: The chart clearly uses two different colors (red and blue) to group the bars, which constitutes a form of visual highlighting. The description contradicts this visual evidence and even its own earlier mention of the colors.
